    AI Overview
    Barnwell County, South Carolina, established in 1798 and located in the Central Savannah River Area, is a rural county with a population of approximately 20,589, featuring a 71% homeownership rate and a median property value of $97,200. Key industries include manufacturing and healthcare, featuring employers like Swiss Krono and Augusta Fiberglass, with a county seat in the city of Barnwell. 
    Key Aspects of Barnwell County: 
    • Geography: Situated on the Coastal Plain, bordered by the Savannah and South Fork Edisto Rivers.
    • Cities and Towns: Key municipalities include the city of Barnwell, Blackville, and Williston.
    • Economy: Major manufacturing companies in the area include Swiss Krono, Augusta Fiberglass Coatings, Inc., and Dayco.
    • Attractions: Notable sites include Barnwell State Park, God's Acre Healing Springs, and Lake Brown.
    • History: Known for the "Barnwell Ring," a group of influential 20th-century state politicians, including Senator Edgar A. Brown, Speaker of the House Solomon Blatt, and Governor Joseph E. Harley.
    • Demographics: The median age is 40.7, with a roughly 2.39% foreign-born population and a median commute of 27.5 minutes.
    • Infrastructure: The Public Works department manages roads and bridges through the County Transportation Committee. 
    For official information regarding county services, property taxes, or council meetings, residents can contact the Administration Building at 57 Wall Street, Barnwell, SC 29812.
